subagent_tokens_note: Subagent transcripts (<session>/subagents/*.jsonl) were never read before 20 September 2026. subagent_tokens on a milestone holds what they recorded, captured while the transcripts still existed, split by model and by cache lifetime. They are counted: tokens_total is tokens_bucket (the parent sessions) plus subagent_tokens, and tokens_cumulative, the totals, the charts and the cost are all built from tokens_total, priced per model. tokens_bucket and tokens_split stay the parent sessions alone, because they are the frozen fact that --enrich checks against the transcripts.
